<PropertyGroup>
  <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
  <Company>Contoso</Company>
  <Authors>Build Team</Authors>
  <Copyright>Copyright 2024 Contoso</Copyright>
</PropertyGroup>
```

**Problem:** `.targets` files are imported *after* the project file. MSBuild uses last-write-wins, so these unconditional assignments **silently override** any project-level customization.   <Company Condition="'$(Company)' == ''">Contoso</Company>

</PropertyGroup>
```

<DefineConstants>ENABLE_LOGGING</DefineConstants>

**Fix:**

**File:** `LibA/LibA.csproj`, line 13

```xml

**Fix:**
```xml

```

**File:** `LibA/LibA.csproj`, lines 43–45

```xml
<Target Name="PublishOnBuild" AfterTargets="Build">
  <MSBuild Projects="$(MSBuildProjectFullPath)" Targets="Publish" Properties="_IsPublishing=true" />
</Target>
```

- Both instances write to the same `OutputPath`/`IntermediateOutputPath`, creating a **file-write race**.
- Errors in the inner Publish invocation produce confusing diagnostics.

</PropertyGroup>

<Compile Include="Domain.fs" />
<Compile Include="Program.fs" />

<Compile Include="Services.fs" />
<Compile Include="Program.fs" />

```
